checks: 46-page Astro build and all 36 site tests passed after the final code change. Local links, assets and fragments resolve; preview noindex and Store exclusion retained.

Automated tests cover source coverage, real-image hashes and licensing, stable saved identities, area grouping, offline escaping of hostile text and unsafe URLs, dates, maximum supported notes and unknown IDs.

Browser visited all seven new pages and checked headings, loaded content and enabled save controls. No horizontal overflow measured at 1910 CSS px. Pratibha Ray and Kui screenshots visually inspected.

Browser saved Chandipur and Similipal into a temporary journey, moved both to day one to verify the multiple-area message, then moved Similipal to day two to verify separate guidance. Offline-download control exercised. Temporary journey deleted; original empty My Odisha Journey retained.

Correction page preselected Chandipur and Kotpad from page query links. Empty draft rejected. Synthetic <script> text appeared as text in the preview without injected elements; download control exercised. No submission or persistence introduced. Clipboard success was not separately verified.

Standalone synthetic book generated with the production helper, rendered at a temporary local URL, and visually inspected. Month-boundary dates, source appendix and personal notes rendered. Zero script, image, external stylesheet, iframe, audio or video elements.
limitations: Founder editorial review and native-language/community review remain pending. Profiles are first introductions, not complete histories; no speaker audio or newly transcribed poems.
No field inspection, property verification or live access calendar. Source-based general seasons and access notes are conditional.

Pratibha Ray sources differ on the early publication date of Jajnaseni; no date is asserted. Indexed CIIL/SCSTRTI/ATLC and Akademi passages are distinguished from full-text inspection in source records.
Offline output is text HTML, not an offline website, image book or editable backup. External links require a connection. Native PDF pagination and physical printing remain unverified.
Correction drafts are not submitted, stored by the project or editorially accepted. No publication rights are implied. Delivery channel remains future work.

This batch verified desktop browser geometry and interactions. Viewport override did not change the measured 1910 CSS px, so new compact layouts, physical devices and screen readers remain unverified; previous 582px checks are not reclassified as this batch evidence.

Browser download controls were exercised, but downloaded browser bytes were not independently retrieved. The same offline generator output was rendered separately and checked to contain no remote resources.
Self-review by the implementing assistant, not independent review. No merge, push or public deployment.
media_note: Pratibha Ray and Chandipur panorama are new real licensed assets with creator, source, licence, date and hash in their canonical JSON. A further Similipal image request returned HTTP 429 and was not used; the previously credited waterfall image remains.
